mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, potentially increasing donepezil plasma concentrations and anticholinesterase effects; berberine may also have additive effects on heart rate and cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor for cholinergic toxicity (nausea, vomiting, bradycardia, syncope) and consider ECG monitoring; dose adjustment of donepezil may be necessary if adverse effects emerge.
